TEXT: These two are Hinata-chan and Tamaki-chan.

They are Kuroneko's younger sisters, who I got to 
know during this summer.
How this situation came to be is easy to explain.
I happened to meet them in town, by chance.

And thus, I got forcibly dragged by Hinata-chan by 
the sleeve and brought here-
It was the starting point, so to speak.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You need life counseling? From me?
Counseling with my friend's cute little sisters.

If it's something I can do, I would do anything for 
them.

TEXT:
Yes, but we still don't know if this person is going to 
be useful.

TEXT: Hey there! I can hear you.

TEXT: You can't fool me by laughing.

sorry.

TEXT: Ruri-onee-sama has been corroded by the darkness.

TEXT: Hey, Hinata-chan. What's up with her?

TEXT: Your sister's always acting weird, though?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
It's nothing like that. This time, it's different from her 
usual self.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
And she isn't getting better. She's always like that, 
the whole time at home, too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...Kukuku... Detestable, how detestable, it is so 
detestable.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Perhaps now, my black-stained heart may be able 
to destroy the world.

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: Onee-sama's heart exists in deep darkness.

TEXT: It's also being a bad influence on Tamaki.

TEXT: Can't you do something about it?
